metaTitle.comment: Home page document title. Shown in the browser tab and as the Google result title. Keep it under ~60 characters.

metaDescription.comment: Home page search-result snippet. One or two sentences, under ~160 characters. Must be unique per language.
metaDescription.value: A small static page in English, with Danish, Arabic, and Russian versions, built to show multilingual URLs and SEO.

ogTitle.comment: Home page Open Graph title. Headline on iMessage, Telegram, Slack, and Facebook cards. Not the Google result title. Keep it short.

ogDescription.comment: Home page Open Graph description. Shown under the title on chat and social share cards. Not the Google snippet.
ogDescription.value: A revolutionary website about saying hello to the world, one unnecessarily localized character at a time. Contains zero useful information and at least one enthusiastic greeting.

ogImageAlt.comment: Accessibility text for the Open Graph share image. Describe the logo; this file has no words on it.
ogImageAlt.value: Hello World app logo: two overlapping rounded squares on a green background

heading.comment: Visible H1 on the home page. Real HTML text, not an image, so search engines can read it.

body.comment: Main paragraph on the home page. Write naturally in this language; do not leave English and translate word-for-word.
body.value: This is a small static website. Each language has its own URL so people and search engines can find the page in their own language.

imageAlt.comment: alt text for the home page hero image. Describe the image in this language. If the image contains words, include those words here.
imageAlt.value: Cartoon cow, dog, and cat under the words Hello world

reviewsHeading.comment: Visible heading above the home page reviews list.

reviewsRating.comment: Numeric star rating. Keep the {rating} placeholder exactly. The build replaces it with 1–5.

reviewsTranslatedFrom.comment: Shown when the review was written in another language. Keep the {language} placeholder exactly.

reviewsVersion.comment: App version the review was written for. Keep the {version} placeholder exactly.

faqHeading.comment: Visible heading above the home page FAQ. Keep it as a real heading, not an image.

faqFreeQuestion.comment: FAQ question. Keep Hello World as the product name.

faqFreeAnswer.comment: FAQ answer. Keep the joke; write naturally in this language.
faqFreeAnswer.value: Yes. We spent all the money on the domain name.

faqToasterQuestion.comment: FAQ question. Keep Hello World as the product name.
faqToasterQuestion.value: Can I use Hello World on my toaster?

faqToasterAnswer.comment: FAQ answer. Keep the joke; write naturally in this language.
faqToasterAnswer.value: Technically, yes. Emotionally, we recommend starting with a computer.

faqRepeatQuestion.comment: FAQ question. Keep Hello World in quotes as the product phrase.
faqRepeatQuestion.value: What happens if I say “Hello World” 100 times?

faqRepeatAnswer.comment: FAQ answer. Keep the joke; write naturally in this language.
faqRepeatAnswer.value: Nothing. But congratulations on completing your first repetitive stress test.

languageNavLabel.comment: Accessible name of the language switcher. Translate this; the language names themselves stay in their native form.

footerNavLabel.comment: Accessible name of the footer link list.

footerTerms.comment: Footer link to the Terms page. Translate the label even though the Terms document itself stays in English.

footerSupport.comment: Footer link to the Support page.

supportMetaTitle.comment: Support page document title. Keep it under ~60 characters.

supportMetaDescription.comment: Support page search-result snippet. Unique per language, under ~160 characters.
supportMetaDescription.value: Having trouble with Hello World? Refresh the page, check your spelling, or email hello@example.com.

supportHeading.comment: Visible H1 on the Support page.

supportIntro.comment: Opening line on the Support page. Keep Hello World as the product name.

supportStep1Title.comment: First troubleshooting step title. Keep the number.

supportStep1Body.value: The oldest trick in the book.

supportStep2Title.comment: Second troubleshooting step title. Keep the number.

supportStep2Body.comment: Second troubleshooting step body. Keep Hello World in quotes as the product phrase.
supportStep2Body.value: “Hello World” is very particular about its letters.

supportStep3Title.comment: Third troubleshooting step title. Keep the number.
supportStep3Title.value: 3. Try turning it off and on again.

supportContact.comment: Keep the {email} placeholder exactly. The build replaces it with a mailto link.
supportContact.value: Still stuck? Contact us at {email} and describe what went wrong.

supportEvidence.comment: Final paragraph on the Support page.
supportEvidence.value: Please include screenshots, error messages, and your best guess at what the computer is angry about.

appStoreHeading.comment: Visible heading above the App Store badge. Keep it short.

appStoreBadgeAlt.comment: alt text for the official Download on the App Store badge. Include the words shown on the badge.
